Resize sends XConfigurNotify with 100x100
2) Window manager gets the request and sends us a resize with 100x100
3) Resize sends XConfigurNotify with 200x200
4) Window manager gets the request and sends us a resize with 200x200
5) We receive 100x100 and trigger our window resize events
6) We receive 200x200 and trigger our window resize events

When this gets combined with autosize,  min/max size properties and any logic that attempts to handle resizes, the entire sequence becomes even more confusing.

So we are recording serials from XConfigureResizeWindow and ignore any events triggered before. 


This ***does not mean*** that we now have a synchronous window resize primitive. ICCCM spec requests window manager to send a correcting ConfigureNotify even if it ignored resize request, however it's not a guarantee that said request will arrive in a timely manner. e. g. KWin will delay ConfigureNotify events till the end of interactive move/resize procedure. Sync resize prospect still needs further investigation and testing.
